🚨🇨🇳| CHINA FACES HMPV OUTBREAK

China’s grappling with a rise in human metapneumovirus (HMPV), causing cough, fever, and congestion—mild for most, but severe for infants and the elderly. No lockdowns planned, but officials expect a bump during Lunar New Year.

• NYT https://t.co/v4DsYzfC6A
